<a id="openness-and-the-rest-theorem--开放与停息定理"></a>
# Openness and the rest theorem

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`continued-change-needs-openness` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](continued-change-needs-openness.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Enclosure excludes endless change: over enclosed steps any change of standing lowers the total, so an enclosed, balanced, dissipative world with finite censuses and embodied arising cannot be refuted to come to rest, its exchange not recurring; the premises decide neither enclosure nor openness.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Where what stands at each step is listed, each once, a step is enclosed around what stands when some family without repetition, closed across the step, holds every condition standing before or after it. (`Becoming.Web.StandingCensus`, `Becoming.Flow.AroundStanding`)
2. Under balance and dissipation, across such a step the total standing falls by at least the number of formations taking from that family, so it does not rise, and any condition's standing rising or falling lowers it: a rise is given to, and giving needs uptake there; a fall is taken from. (`Becoming.Flow.standing_runs_down`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_never_rises`, `Becoming.Flow.change_lowers`, `Becoming.Flow.rise_lowers_on`, `Becoming.Flow.fall_lowers_on`)
3. So where every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, no condition's standing changes at arbitrarily late steps; each enclosure need only be not refuted, since what is compared are numbers. (`Becoming.Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around`)
4. Read of worlds: where what stands is listed, whatever arises is embodied, the flow balances and dissipates and every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, that arising stops from some step on cannot be refuted. (`Becoming.World.arising_stops_unrefuted`)
5. The rest theorem: a world with a census of what is active and of what stands, whose arising is embodied, with a balanced, dissipative flow, in which every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, is such that its resting from some step on (World.RestsFrom) cannot be refuted, so neither arising nor ceasing recurs. (`Becoming.World.comes_to_rest_unrefuted`)
6. That standing stops changing from some step on cannot be refuted, so that embodied arising stops from some step on cannot be refuted either: it is not the case that after every step from then on a later arising stays unrefuted. (`Becoming.World.arising_stops_unrefuted_from`, `Becoming.Flow.change_stops_unrefuted`)
7. The census is a list covering what is active, under which ceasing recurring leaves a later arising unrefuted after every step, which the unrefuted stopping refutes, so that ceasing stops from some step on cannot be refuted either, with no decision procedure; World.comes_to_rest_unrefuted_from asks only for a list covering what is active at each step from then on. (`Becoming.Covers.not_not_coming_from`, `Becoming.World.comes_to_rest_unrefuted_from`)
8. Both censuses are needed: in attrition nothing stands and nothing flows, every other premise holds, every step is enclosed around what stands, and ceasing recurs. (`Becoming.World.attrition`, `Becoming.World.rest_needs_census`)
9. In throughput what is active is listed, whatever arises is embodied, the flow balances and dissipates and every step is enclosed around every relatum ever active, yet every unburnt fuel stands, so what stands cannot be listed, and arising never ceases; in embodiedThroughput, the same flow with every relatum embodied, every step is enclosed, nothing active can be listed, and arising never ceases. (`Becoming.World.throughput`, `Becoming.World.embodiedThroughput`, `Becoming.World.rest_needs_standing`)
10. So the world itself need not be finite, but finitely many must stand and finitely many be active at each step; in a world whose rest is so unrefuted, not unboundedly many relata are ever active and not unboundedly many ever stand, with no decision procedure: beyond finite worlds the rest theorem covers only relata that never stand or act. (`Becoming.World.rest_few`, `Becoming.Listed.few_of_stop_unrefuted`)
11. The stronger form, some list holding every member that ever holds, needs omniscience in general: if every determination listed at each step whose coming to hold does not recur had such a list, even one listing at most one member at each step and coming to hold at most once, the limited principle of omniscience LPO would hold. (`Becoming.Listed.lpo_of_few`, `Becoming.Few.listed`, `Becoming.LPO`)
12. The exchange does not recur either: across a step enclosed around what stands, a formation taking part that takes or gives anything lowers the total standing, since the enclosing family holds what it exchanges and under dissipation giving to it needs taking from it; so where every step from some step on is, not refutably, enclosed around what stands, no formation takes or gives at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Flow.exchange_lowers`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_not_recurring_around`, `Becoming.World.exchange_not_recurring`)
13. This needs only the census of what stands, balance, dissipation and enclosure, neither the census of what is active nor embodiment, and each of the four is needed, the others holding and the exchange recurring without it: without enclosure in exposed, which meets all eight premises. (`Becoming.World.exchange_needs`, `Becoming.World.exposed`)
14. Without dissipation in the cycle of Becoming.Flow, its one condition standing throughout, the flow balanced and every step enclosed around it; without balance in leaking, dissipative, every step enclosed around the side holding the standing; without the census of what stands in throughput, balanced, dissipative and enclosed at every step, what stands not being listable. (`Becoming.World.exchange_needs`, `Becoming.Cycle.flow`, `Becoming.World.leaking`, `Becoming.World.throughput`)
15. Its cases: a finite world lists what stands and is enclosed around it at every step, and the finite rest, World.rests_unrefuted of Becoming.Space, states the same conclusion of finite worlds, its relata covering what is active, with no decision procedure. (`Becoming.World.Finite.standing`, `Becoming.World.rests_unrefuted`)
16. Where every relatum is embodied, the census of what is active lists what stands; an enclosed step is not not enclosed around what stands, so enclosure from some step on suffices, with no decision of equality. (`Becoming.World.rests_unrefuted_around`, `Becoming.Flow.Enclosed.aroundStanding_not_not`, `Becoming.World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed`)
17. Read the other way, arising without end in such a world is incompatible with every step from some step on being enclosed: it is enclosed from no step on. (`Becoming.World.arising_opens`)
18. The eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness: the sides of Shuttle, also taking a unit from each of infinitely many ground relata and giving it back at every step, meet all eight premises of Becoming.Premises and keep arising without end; no step is enclosed, so dissipation, which binds only at enclosed steps, binds at none. (`Becoming.World.exposed_world`)
19. Its total standing is one at every step, the holder falling across each, and the ground relata stand at nothing. (`Becoming.World.exposed_standing`)
20. Nor does openness with the eight give arising without end: a holder taking a unit from each ground relatum and giving it back at every step meets the eight with no step enclosed, and nothing arises or ceases; mutualists active throughout meet all eight with every step enclosed and arising does not recur. (`Becoming.World.holding_world`, `Becoming.World.openness_contingent`)
21. In hatch, where every premise binds (hatch_binds of map-of-premises), the child arises and the parent ceases, every step is enclosed, and that the world, though not finite, its ground relata idle, rests from some step on cannot be refuted. (`Becoming.World.hatch_rests_unrefuted`)
22. Every premise binding does not bring rest: in a queue closed once in which one member replaces another at every step (World.onceClosedQueue of whole-law-of-counting) every premise binds, and arising and ceasing both recur. (`Becoming.World.binding_contingent`)
23. The laws hold of every world in a local form: a census of what stands and, from some step on, it not refuted that what stands runs down (closed, for the exchange), with no premise on the flow; Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around, exchange_not_recurring_around (and World.arising_stops_unrefuted through them) are their corollaries. (`Becoming.Flow.change_not_recurring_from`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_not_recurring_from`, `Becoming.World.arising_not_recurring_from`)
24. The premises are one way of supplying the local condition: the exact form for every world is in laws-of-one-step, where running down needs no closure, and this record's standing rest theorems are its corollaries.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The standing law (`Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around`): balance; dissipation; a census of what stands (the conditions standing at each step listed, each once, so finitely many stand at each step); every step from some step on enclosed around what stands.
- Read of worlds. Arising stopping unrefuted (arising_stops_unrefuted): a census of what stands and whatever arises embodied.
- The rest theorem (comes_to_rest_unrefuted): also a census of what is active; activity need not be decided (P58), the census serving only as a list covering what is active (comes_to_rest_unrefuted_from).
- rests_unrefuted_around, rests_unrefuted_enclosed, arising_opens: a census of what is active and every relatum embodied, which together give the census of what stands; no decision of equality is needed.
- exposed_world, exposed_standing, openness_contingent, rest_needs_census and rest_needs_standing are statements about particular worlds, with no premise.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The exchange coming to rest is stated as no exchange at arbitrarily late steps (a negated recurrence), not as a step after which none occurs, which would need a decision.
- In a world meeting the rest theorem's conditions not unboundedly many relata ever stand or act, a list holding all of them needing omniscience in general, so the generalization lies only in idle relata. Witness: `Becoming.Listed.lpo_of_few`.
- Openness with the eight premises does not suffice for arising without end, nor does every premise binding bring rest. Witness: `Becoming.World.holding_world`.
- In exposed three premises hold vacuously, a feature of representing dissipation as binding only enclosed exchange, not a description of actual open systems.
- Amounts are natural numbers: dissipation loses a whole unit per taking step; with real amounts losses can shrink geometrically and rest fails, and the second law gives no least loss per step.
- **Counterexample:** exposed: meets all eight premises, no step enclosed, and arising never ceases; so the condition of enclosure cannot be dropped. Activity needing support, bounded transmission and dissipation hold vacuously in it. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)
- **Counterexample:** attrition: meets every premise of the rest theorem but the census of what is active, every step enclosed around what stands, and ceasing recurs; so that census is needed (World.rest_needs_census). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)
- **Counterexample:** throughput and embodiedThroughput: every step enclosed, balanced and dissipative, and arising never ceases; throughput has a census of what is active and embodied arising but no census of what stands, and embodiedThroughput has every relatum embodied but no census; so finitely many standing at each step is needed (World.rest_needs_standing). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Mutualists: meet all eight premises, every step enclosed, and arising does not recur; with exposed, the eight premises decide neither enclosure nor openness (World.openness_contingent). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)
- **Counterexample:** holding: meets all eight premises with no step enclosed, and nothing arises or ceases; so openness is necessary for arising without end, not sufficient (World.holding_world, the independent review's R8). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)
- **Counterexample:** exchange_needs: in the cycle of Becoming.Flow (enclosed, balanced, not dissipative), leaking (enclosed, dissipative, not balanced) and throughput (enclosed, balanced, dissipative, what stands not listable) the exchange recurs at arbitrarily late steps, as in exposed (all eight premises, no step enclosed); so none of the four premises of the exchange coming to rest can be dropped. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)
- **Counterexample:** World.binding_contingent: in hatch every premise binds and arising stops; in a queue closed once in which one member replaces another at every step every premise binds, and arising and ceasing recur. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counting.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The rests of space-and-its-parts makes a world's rest unrefutable through finiteness; this result shows that the world itself need not be finite: what does the work is finitely many standing and finitely many active at each step (the two censuses), with enclosure around what stands; finiteness works in two ways, giving the censuses and giving enclosure, and the two can be asked for separately. throughput and embodiedThroughput show that finitely many standing at each step cannot be dropped, attrition that the census of what is active cannot, and exposed that enclosure cannot, while holding shows that openness does not suffice for arising without end. rests_unrefuted and rests_unrefuted_around here are two cases of one rest theorem: a finite world has both censuses and is enclosed at every step, and where every relatum is embodied the two censuses are one. The author's reading (an AI argument): under balance and dissipation the total standing is a quantity that falls and never rises; every arising (for an embodied relatum, coming to stand) and every ceasing (for an embodied relatum, ceasing to stand) lowers it, so in an unfolding enclosed and with finitely many standing at each step, changes of standing do not happen at arbitrarily late steps (changes of activity need the census of activity as well, attrition). The reach of this generalization: in a world whose rest is so unrefuted, not unboundedly many relata ever stand or act (rest_few), so it covers beyond rests_unrefuted only relata that never stand or act (the eleventh independent review's R3). Arising without end therefore needs openness: not every step from some step on enclosed, that is, exchange beyond every finite family. This is the family-level openness of no-finite-part-bears-taking and generation-is-replenishment stated of worlds, over the changing list of what stands rather than a fixed family. At world level openness is exchange beyond every finite family and need not be inflow: exposed exchanges at zero net, its total standing stays at one, and what is unbounded is the number of relata it exchanges with, each at zero; on Ren's delegation ‘openness’ names exchange beyond every finite family, and inflow is gain, stated separately (DELEGATED-CHOICES D7; where-novelty-gain-comes-from). In exposed, activity needing support and bounded transmission hold vacuously, since nothing depends on anything, and dissipation holds vacuously, since no step is enclosed; the rest theorem uses four premises. That dissipation binds only enclosed exchange is a disclosed feature of its representation (Spray, from the corrections after the sixth independent review). The readings and names of ‘openness’, ‘enclosed’ and ‘what stands’ are the AI's formulations, adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36); the result evaluates neither openness nor rest.
